def factor_volume_accel_reversal(df):
    """Volume acceleration reversal: reversal signal amplified solely by volume acceleration."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    ema_vol_5 = volume.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5).mean()
    ema_vol_20 = volume.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_accel = ema_vol_5 / (ema_vol_20 + 1e-12) - 1.0
    reversal = -close.pct_change(5)
    factor = reversal * vol_accel
    factor = factor.clip(-2.0, 2.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_accel_reversal"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_accel_reversal"]
description: Simplify parent by removing redundant volume regime multiplier. The volume acceleration (ratio of short-term to long-term volume EMA) already captures the temporal surge structure; removing the overall volume level (vol_ratio) reduces noise and model complexity while preserving the core reversal-amplification mechanism. Expected to maintain or improve RankIC and ICIR by reducing over-weighting of volume level extremes.
